Check against design.md D1-D17: X-Trace-Id on every response incl. 401/404/429/5xx (WebFilter, beforeCommit, observation context); shared SLO buckets as whole ms; no user id/email/IP/raw path in metric labels; no token/cookie/Authorization/X-Forwarded-For in logs or spans; no route matches /actuator/**; logback exporter loggers never reach the OTEL appender; pinned appender 2.15.0-alpha matches OTel SDK 1.49.0.
